data.name: Till
data.long_meaning: The name Till is rooted in the Old High German word 'til', meaning 'mighty' or 'valiant'. This name was popular during the Middle Ages and was often given to warriors and strong leaders. In the New Testament, the name is also associated with Till Eulenspiegel, a legendary folktale character known for his pranks and wisdom.
